name: CRM Contact Update
description: Search for a contact in a CRM, open their record, update a field, and save the changes.
intent: Find a CRM contact and update their record with new information

steps.intent: Navigate to the CRM contacts section
steps.context_hint: Look for a 'Contacts', 'People', or 'Customers' link in the main navigation

steps.intent: Search for the contact by name
steps.context_hint: A search or filter input within the contacts list

steps.intent: Wait for search results to filter and verify the contact appears
steps.verification: The target contact is visible in the filtered list

steps.intent: Click on the contact to open their detail record
steps.context_hint: The contact row or card in the search results

steps.intent: Click the edit button or make the target field editable
steps.context_hint: An 'Edit' button, pencil icon, or click directly on the field to make it editable

steps.intent: Clear the existing value in the target field and enter the new value
steps.context_hint: The field specified by the field_name variable
A 'Save', 'Update', or checkmark button to confirm changes
steps.verification: Success notification appears or the field shows the updated value

steps.intent: Verify the record was saved with the new value
steps.verification: The field now displays the updated value {{new_value}}
